comments.body: Rockgar (and coords 25,10) are in Loch Modan even though the quest appears in the Wetlands category in your quest log.
How do you get this quest? Do you need to be level 19 or are there other quests you must do before this one? (I have done all other Kadrell quests to this point)

he's at the gate to dun algaz in LOCH MODAN

coordinates are 25,10

Rockgar is standing at the gate.
Cord: 25.10
Think there's a prerequisite quest - maybe to do with the keg of evershine...
Verified today it is attain at level 19.

This quest leads to [quest=455] which rewards a measly 1,250 exp. Not worth doing imo.

Edit: If you are able to kill things extremely fast (ie, multiboxer, or have a group), and you're already en route to wetlands, this can be a decently efficient quest to do.
This says Attain 18, but I am level 18 and its not yet available. Unfortunate too, cause I have to go to Dun Modr for the next part of A Dark Threat Looms, which is level 18.
